vetSays.line: A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
🌱 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
📓 Journal: the person in their 30s, with a broad frame taught the person in their 30s, with a scarred cheek Reading Tracks.
📋 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. (a natural — good pick) They'll report back by next part.
🛡️ Tiana, Manuel, Guangming and Liam met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Manuel, Guangming, Liam are hurt.
🛡️ Manuel, Leomarys and Guangming met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Manuel, Guangming are hurt.
🛡️ Liam, Amina and Hannah met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Liam, Hannah are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leomarys just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Leomarys and Amina met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leomarys just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
(Scarred Big Big's hide absorbs 6.)
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
Scarred Big Big is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
You STRIKE the Scarred Big Big for 71 (Hunting spear).
(Scarred Big Big's hide absorbs 6.)
You STRIKE the Scarred Big Big for 77 (Hunting spear).
The Scarred Big Big falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Big Big!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Amina just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Leomarys, Amina and Dale met them at the door — 3 put down. Leomarys, Amina, Dale are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
